LESSON: KUSOMA 5.2.1 KUSOMA KWA UFAHAMU USHAIRI

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: KISWAHILI
Strand: KUKABILIANA NA UMASKINI Mada Mada Ndogo Matokeo Maalum Yanayotarajiwa Shughuli z
Topic 5.2: Kusoma 5.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu Ushairi

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo tutajifunza kuhusu Kusoma 5.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu Ushairi. Soma, angalia mifano, fanya mazoezi, kisha jaribu jaribio la marekebisho.

SEHEMU 2: UTAPATA KUJUA NINI

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. kutambua mizani na vina katika shairi ili kuvibainisha
2. kusoma shairi akizingatia vina mizani na ujumbe ili kuimarisha ufahamu

SEHEMU 3: JIFUNZE HATUA KWA HATUA

1. kutambua mizani na vina katika shairi ili kuvibainisha
   In simple words: practise until you can kutambua mizani na vina katika shairi ili kuvibainisha. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. kusoma shairi akizingatia vina mizani na ujumbe ili kuimarisha ufahamu
   In simple words: practise until you can kusoma shairi akizingatia vina mizani na ujumbe ili kuimarisha ufahamu. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO

Example 1: Talk about Kusoma 5.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu Ushairi using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 5: JARIBU HIVI

1. Underline two new ideas about Kusoma 5.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu Ushairi in the examples.
2. Explain Kusoma 5.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu Ushairi to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Kusoma 5.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu Ushairi.
4. Show that you can: kutambua mizani na vina katika shairi ili kuvibainisha

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA KUFANYA

1. Write five sentences about Kusoma 5.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu Ushairi using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Kusoma 5.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu Ushairi important for a Grade 5 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. kutambua mizani na vina katika shairi ili kuvibainisha
2. kusoma shairi akizingatia vina mizani na ujumbe ili kuimarisha ufahamu

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
